newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS ONE-WK REV REPO TENDER RATE DOWN.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK SAYS ONE-WK REV REPO TENDER RATE DOWN.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday said the average rate at its seven-day securities reverse repurchase tender eased to 14.60 percent, from 14.95 percent on Thursday.
The NBS added in a statement that it had drained funds totalling 1.27 billion crowns.
The NBS added the maximum bid in the tender was 15.4 percent, while the minimum bid rate hit 10.5 percent.
The NBS added the tender was fully subscribed with all 1.27 billion crowns worth of bids being accepted.
NBS reverse repo rates have been declining since last Friday due to lower bids by commercial banks.
On Thursday the NBS said it had cut reverse repo rate to give a signal to the market that rates should go down.
